items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: He did a wonderful album a long time ago which was a tribute to Sidney Bechet

ctx.x: Is the music more popular over there? His kind of music?

Yes. He does his version of Klezmer music so he has kind of, he mixes it with jazz or funk, whatever. He did a wonderful album a long time ago which was a tribute to Sidney Bechet, so it was his version of playing Klezmer with that early Sidney Bechet kind of music and he joined them together. And it came out very interesting. He’s a very interesting artist. So he does a sort of a mix of that traditional Klezmer which you might even hear at a bar mitzvah or a Jewish wedding or something, and mixed with all of his…
And you’ve got to find your place in that music.
